title: The Collective Provides: 2,500 cr once, the link after Network Expansion; 20 nickel ore mined at GSC-0049 Platinum-Group Reef, handed in at Central Nexus
note: Architect Vex-9 on the Central Nexus board, the link after Network Expansion: mine 20 nickel ore, 2,500 cr once, voidborn mastery XP. No home field holds nickel; GSC-0049 Platinum-Group Reef (lawless, 5 jumps) read 192 nickel at 07:47 UTC, Gliese 876 618 (a pirate seen there at 04:40 UTC, Intel). Test by hand, one trader, 08:47 to 09:32 UTC: hold stored at Central Nexus, accepted, mined at the reef, handed in at Central Nexus: RESULT +2,188 cr after fuel in 48 minutes (data/routes/runs.jsonl). The reef gives nickel, platinum, rhodium, osmium and iridium together: the hold filled with 14 nickel among 58 units, the mining loop took it home to storage and went back, so a run is two trips. The other ores have no bid above 2 cr at our stations (books of 09:05 UTC): stored, not sold. The hand-in opens a tree of voidborn mastery missions on the same board: The Signal Protocol, Crystal Resonance Harvest, Deep Core Prospecting, Atmospheric Extraction: Setup, Material Synthesis: Basic, Network Commerce Protocol, Hardware Optimization: Cargo, Threat Neutralization Protocol (not flown: it asks to destroy a pirate, orders F2). requires.booked Network Expansion; max_ships 2 while the reef's nickel is the only read source within reach. Stamped 2026-11-16 09:34 UTC.
